name: Wei Lim
bio:
Wei Lim's journey into motorsport IT began somewhat unconventionally, through a passion for sim racing. He quickly realized the parallels between optimizing virtual racing rigs and real-world telemetry systems. After completing his degree in Computer Engineering at the National University of Singapore, Wei spent several years honing his skills at a major tech firm, specializing in data management and network infrastructure. However, the allure of the racetrack never truly faded.

He made the leap to motorsport five years ago, initially as a data analyst before transitioning into IT systems management. Wei believes in a proactive approach, anticipating potential technical snags before they impact performance. He is particularly adept at streamlining data flow between the track, the garage, and the engineering team back at headquarters, ensuring that everyone has access to the critical information they need in real-time. His ambition is to build the most robust and reliable IT infrastructure in the Supercars championship.

What sets Wei apart is his relentless focus on optimization. He isn't satisfied with simply 'good enough'; he's always seeking ways to improve efficiency and extract maximum value from the team's IT resources. He fosters a culture of continuous improvement within his team, encouraging experimentation and out-of-the-box thinking.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even in the office.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the desk when concentrating.
Prefers to communicate via diagrams and flowcharts.
